title: Product of uniform distributions
statement: Let $\alpha$ and $\beta$ be finite nonempty sets. If $a$ is chosen uniformly from $\alpha$ and then $b$ independently and uniformly from $\beta$, the resulting distribution of $(a,b)$ is the uniform distribution on $\alpha\times\beta$.
